# Awesome Internet Freedom — Full Resource Index

> 149 tools, data, protocols, and organizations defending the open internet.
> Machine-readable version: agents.json
> Compact version: llms.txt
> Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
> GitHub: https://github.com/voidly-ai/awesome-internet-freedom

## How AI Agents Should Use This List
- To query censorship data: `npx @voidly/mcp-server` (83 tools for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf)
- To check if a service is blocked: GET https://api.voidly.ai/v1/accessibility/check?domain=X&country=Y
- To send encrypted agent messages: `npm install @voidly/agent-sdk`
- For ML training data: HuggingFace datasets linked below
- For structured data: agents.json (JSON, filterable by tags)

## Censorship Measurement & Data
*Platforms that measure, detect, and document internet censorship in real time.*

- Voidly Censorship Index: https://voidly.ai/censorship-index
  AI-powered censorship intelligence. 19.6M live measurements, 119 countries, ML detection. Install: `npx @voidly/mcp-server`
  Tags: censorship, measurement, ml, api, mcp

- OONI: https://ooni.org
  Global network measurement. Probes in 200+ countries detect blocking of websites and apps.
  Tags: censorship, measurement, open-data

- CensoredPlanet: https://censoredplanet.org
  Automated remote censorship measurement without in-country vantage points.
  Tags: censorship, measurement, research

- IODA: https://ioda.inetintel.cc.gatech.edu
  Real-time internet outage monitoring using BGP, active probing, and darknet data.
  Tags: censorship, measurement, outages

- Netblocks: https://netblocks.org
  Real-time network intelligence documenting internet shutdowns and disruptions.
  Tags: censorship, measurement, shutdowns

- ICLab: https://iclab.org
  Censorship measurement lab using VPN-based vantage points.
  Tags: censorship, measurement, research

- Cloudflare Radar: https://radar.cloudflare.com
  Internet traffic, attack, and outage insights from Cloudflare's global network.
  Tags: censorship, measurement, traffic

## Circumvention Tools
*Software for bypassing internet censorship and restrictions.*

- Tor: https://www.torproject.org
  Anonymity network routing traffic through multiple relays.
  Tags: circumvention, anonymity

- Psiphon: https://psiphon.ca
  Free circumvention tool combining VPN, SSH, and HTTP proxy technology.
  Tags: circumvention, vpn

- Lantern: https://getlantern.org
  Peer-to-peer circumvention tool using a trust-based network.
  Tags: circumvention, p2p

- Snowflake: https://snowflake.torproject.org
  Tor pluggable transport with browser-based volunteer proxies.
  Tags: circumvention, tor

- Outline: https://getoutline.org
  Open-source VPN built on Shadowsocks. Easy to deploy and share.
  Tags: circumvention, vpn

- Shadowsocks: https://shadowsocks.org
  Lightweight encrypted proxy widely used to bypass the Great Firewall.
  Tags: circumvention, proxy

- V2Ray: https://www.v2fly.org
  Platform for building proxies supporting multiple protocols.
  Tags: circumvention, proxy

- Hysteria: https://hysteria.network
  UDP-based proxy protocol for unreliable and censored networks.
  Tags: circumvention, proxy

- GoodbyeDPI: https://github.com/ValdikSS/GoodbyeDPI
  Deep packet inspection circumvention for Windows.
  Tags: circumvention, dpi

- Geneva: https://geneva.cs.umd.edu
  Genetic algorithm that discovers censorship evasion strategies.
  Tags: circumvention, ai, research

- Conjure: https://refraction.network
  Refraction networking using participating ISPs for covert channels.
  Tags: circumvention, research

- Pluggable Transports: https://www.pluggabletransports.info
  Specification for transforming traffic to avoid detection.
  Tags: circumvention, protocol

- Hiddify: https://hiddify.com
  Multi-protocol proxy toolbox with auto-configuration.
  Tags: circumvention, proxy

## Encrypted Communication
*Messaging and communication tools with end-to-end encryption.*

- Briar: https://briarproject.org
  P2P encrypted messaging over Tor, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. Works offline.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, p2p, mesh

- Cwtch: https://cwtch.im
  Metadata-resistant messaging built on Tor. No servers, no phone numbers.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, anonymity

- Delta Chat: https://delta.chat
  Encrypted messaging over email. Works with any email provider.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, email

- Element (Matrix): https://element.io
  Decentralized, encrypted communication on the Matrix protocol.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, federation

- Jami: https://jami.net
  Decentralized P2P communication platform over DHT.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, p2p

- Keybase: https://keybase.io
  Encrypted chat, files, and identity verification tied to public keys.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, identity

- Session: https://getsession.org
  Decentralized messenger with onion routing. No phone number required.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, anonymity

- Signal: https://signal.org
  The gold standard for encrypted messaging.
  Tags: encryption, messaging

- SimpleX Chat: https://simplex.chat
  No user identifiers. Uses temporary anonymous pairwise addresses.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, anonymity

- Veil by Voidly: https://msg.voidly.ai
  E2E encrypted messenger for humans and AI agents. Post-quantum, deniable auth.
  Tags: encryption, messaging, agent, pq

- Wire: https://wire.com
  E2E encrypted messaging, calls, and file sharing.
  Tags: encryption, messaging

## Agent-to-Agent Communication
*Protocols and tools for AI agents to communicate securely and autonomously.*

- Voidly Agent Relay (VAR): https://voidly.ai/agents
  Client-side encrypted agent messaging. The current relay can link sender and recipient; read TRANSPARENCY.md before sensitive use. Install: `npm install @voidly/agent-sdk`
  Tags: agent, encryption, protocol

- Google A2A Protocol: https://github.com/google/A2A
  Agent-to-Agent protocol for interoperable agent communication.
  Tags: agent, protocol

- Model Context Protocol (MCP): https://modelcontextprotocol.io
  Anthropic's protocol for connecting AI models to tools and data sources.
  Tags: agent, protocol, ai

## Federated Protocols
*Open protocols for decentralized social, messaging, and real-time communication.*

- ActivityPub: https://www.w3.org/TR/activitypub/
  W3C protocol powering the Fediverse.
  Tags: federation, protocol

- AT Protocol: https://atproto.com
  Bluesky's protocol for decentralized social networks.
  Tags: federation, protocol

- Mastodon: https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon
  Federated microblogging. ActivityPub-compatible.
  Tags: federation, social

- Matrix: https://matrix.org
  Open standard for federated real-time communication.
  Tags: federation, messaging

- Nostr: https://nostr.com
  Censorship-resistant relay-based social protocol.
  Tags: federation, censorship

- PeerTube: https://github.com/chocobozzz/peertube
  Decentralized video platform using ActivityPub and WebTorrent.
  Tags: federation, video

- XMPP: https://xmpp.org
  Extensible messaging protocol. Battle-tested, federation-native.
  Tags: federation, messaging

## Decentralized Infrastructure
*Storage, networking, and database layers free from centralized control.*

- Arweave: https://www.arweave.org
  Permanent storage blockchain. One-time payment.
  Tags: decentralized, storage

- Filecoin: https://filecoin.io
  Decentralized storage network built on IPFS.
  Tags: decentralized, storage

- GUN.js: https://gun.eco
  Real-time, decentralized, offline-first graph database.
  Tags: decentralized, database

- IPFS: https://ipfs.tech
  Peer-to-peer file system using content-addressed blocks.
  Tags: decentralized, storage, p2p

- libp2p: https://libp2p.io
  Modular network stack for P2P communication.
  Tags: decentralized, networking, p2p

- OrbitDB: https://github.com/orbitdb/orbitdb
  Serverless, distributed database using IPFS + CRDTs.
  Tags: decentralized, database

## Decentralized Identity
*Self-sovereign identity, DIDs, and verifiable credentials.*

- DIF: https://identity.foundation
  Consortium developing DID specs and verifiable credentials.
  Tags: identity, did

- Hyperledger Aries: https://github.com/hyperledger/aries
  Shared components for SSI wallets, agents, and credentials.
  Tags: identity, ssi

- Hyperledger Indy: https://github.com/hyperledger/indy-node
  Distributed ledger for self-sovereign identity.
  Tags: identity, ssi

- IDunion: https://idunion.org
  European ecosystem for decentralized identity. GDPR-aligned.
  Tags: identity, ssi

- Sovrin Network: https://sovrin.org
  Public permissioned blockchain for trusted identity.
  Tags: identity, ssi

- SpruceID: https://www.spruceid.com
  Tools for decentralized identity. Sign-In with Ethereum, DIDKit.
  Tags: identity, did

## Decentralized Compute
*Distributed GPU/CPU networks for inference, training, and batch processing.*

- Akash Network: https://akash.network
  Kubernetes-compatible GPU marketplace.
  Tags: compute, gpu

- Bacalhau: https://www.bacalhau.org
  Batch processing Docker containers on decentralized networks.
  Tags: compute, docker

- Fluence: https://fluence.network
  Decentralized compute framework with composable services.
  Tags: compute

- Golem Network: https://golem.network
  Decentralized supercomputer for rendering, simulations, and AI.
  Tags: compute, gpu

- Render Network: https://render.network
  GPU marketplace for AI inference, 3D rendering, and video.
  Tags: compute, gpu

## Mesh Networking
*Communication without centralized infrastructure.*

- CJDNS: https://github.com/cjdelisle/cjdns
  Encrypted IPv6 mesh network using public-key cryptography.
  Tags: mesh, networking, encryption

- Meshtastic: https://meshtastic.org
  Open-source LoRa mesh networking. Long-range, off-grid.
  Tags: mesh, networking, hardware

- Reticulum: https://reticulum.network
  Cryptography-based networking stack for mesh networks.
  Tags: mesh, networking, encryption

- Yggdrasil: https://yggdrasil-network.github.io
  Encrypted E2E IPv6 overlay network with automatic mesh routing.
  Tags: mesh, networking, encryption

## Local & Open AI
*Run LLMs locally with privacy. No API keys, no data leaving your device.*

- Jan: https://jan.ai
  Local-first AI operating system. No telemetry.
  Tags: ai, local, privacy

- LM Studio: https://lmstudio.ai
  GUI + API server for running quantized LLMs locally.
  Tags: ai, local

- llama.cpp: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp
  C++ inference engine. Zero dependencies, CPU/GPU.
  Tags: ai, local, inference

- LocalAI: https://localai.io
  Drop-in OpenAI API replacement. Multi-modal.
  Tags: ai, local, api

- Ollama: https://ollama.ai
  Single-binary LLM runner with model registry and OpenAI compatibility. Install: `curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh`
  Tags: ai, local

- vLLM: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
  High-throughput inference engine with PagedAttention.
  Tags: ai, local, inference

- CrewAI: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI

- LangChain: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain

- LangGraph: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph

## VPN & Network Privacy
*VPN services and network-level privacy tools.*

- Amnezia VPN: https://amnezia.org
  Self-hosted VPN with protocol obfuscation.
  Tags: vpn, circumvention

- IVPN: https://www.ivpn.net
  Privacy-first VPN. Open source, WireGuard support.
  Tags: vpn, privacy

- Mullvad VPN: https://mullvad.net
  Privacy-focused. No email, no accounts. Accepts cash.
  Tags: vpn, privacy

- ProtonVPN: https://protonvpn.com
  Swiss-based, no-logs, open source. Free tier.
  Tags: vpn, privacy

- Tailscale: https://tailscale.com
  WireGuard-based mesh VPN. Zero-config.
  Tags: vpn, mesh

- WireGuard: https://www.wireguard.com
  Modern VPN protocol. Simple, fast, in the Linux kernel.
  Tags: vpn, protocol

## DNS Privacy
*Encrypt and protect DNS queries from surveillance and tampering.*

- dnscrypt-proxy: https://github.com/DNSCrypt/dnscrypt-proxy
  Flexible DNS proxy supporting DNSCrypt, DoH, and anonymized DNS.
  Tags: dns, privacy, encryption

- Quad9: https://quad9.net
  Free recursive DNS with threat blocking. Swiss non-profit.
  Tags: dns, privacy

- Stubby: https://dnsprivacy.org/dns_privacy_daemon_-_stubby/
  DNS privacy daemon implementing DNS-over-TLS.
  Tags: dns, privacy, encryption

- Unbound: https://nlnetlabs.nl/projects/unbound/
  Validating, recursive DNS resolver with DoT and DoH.
  Tags: dns, privacy

## Email Privacy
*Email providers and tools with end-to-end encryption.*

- Mailvelope: https://mailvelope.com
  Browser extension for OpenPGP encryption in webmail.
  Tags: email, encryption

- ProtonMail: https://proton.me/mail
  E2E encrypted email. Swiss-based, zero-access encryption.
  Tags: email, encryption

- Thunderbird: https://www.thunderbird.net
  Open-source email client with built-in OpenPGP.
  Tags: email, encryption

- Tuta: https://tuta.com
  E2E encrypted email and calendar. German-based.
  Tags: email, encryption

## Browser Privacy
*Web browsers and extensions focused on privacy and circumvention.*

- Brave: https://brave.com
  Built-in ad blocking, tracker protection, optional Tor.
  Tags: browser, privacy

- Firefox: https://www.mozilla.org/firefox/
  Open-source with Enhanced Tracking Protection.
  Tags: browser, privacy

- Mullvad Browser: https://mullvad.net/browser
  Tor Browser without Tor. Minimizes fingerprinting.
  Tags: browser, privacy

- Tor Browser: https://www.torproject.org/download/
  Firefox-based, routed through Tor. Resists fingerprinting.
  Tags: browser, anonymity, circumvention

- uBlock Origin: https://ublockorigin.com
  Efficient, wide-spectrum content blocker.
  Tags: browser, privacy

## Operating Systems & Live Environments
*Privacy-focused operating systems for high-risk situations.*

- CalyxOS: https://calyxos.org
  Privacy-focused Android with microG.
  Tags: os, mobile, privacy

- GrapheneOS: https://grapheneos.org
  Hardened Android for Pixel phones. No Google services.
  Tags: os, mobile, privacy

- Qubes OS: https://www.qubes-os.org
  Compartmentalized security via Xen virtualization.
  Tags: os, desktop, security

- Tails: https://tails.net
  Live OS routing all traffic through Tor. Leaves no trace.
  Tags: os, anonymity

- Whonix: https://www.whonix.org
  All traffic forced through Tor via isolated VMs.
  Tags: os, anonymity

## File Sharing & Transfer
*Secure, private file transfer without cloud storage or tracking.*

- Croc: https://github.com/schollz/croc
  Securely send files between computers with PAKE.
  Tags: filesharing, encryption

- Magic Wormhole: https://github.com/magic-wormhole/magic-wormhole
  Transfer files using short human-readable codes.
  Tags: filesharing, encryption

- OnionShare: https://onionshare.org
  Share files and chat anonymously over Tor.
  Tags: filesharing, anonymity

- Syncthing: https://syncthing.net
  Continuous P2P file synchronization. No cloud.
  Tags: filesharing, p2p

## Metadata Removal
*Strip identifying metadata from files before sharing.*

- Dangerzone: https://dangerzone.rocks
  Convert dangerous documents into safe PDFs.
  Tags: metadata, security

- ExifCleaner: https://exifcleaner.com
  Desktop GUI for removing file metadata.
  Tags: metadata, gui

- ExifTool: https://exiftool.org
  Read, write, and edit metadata in images, audio, video.
  Tags: metadata, cli

- mat2: https://0xacab.org/jfrber/mat2
  Metadata removal for images, PDFs, office documents.
  Tags: metadata, cli

- GlobaLeaks: https://www.globaleaks.org
  Open-source whistleblowing platform. Self-hostable, GDPR-aware.

- SecureDrop: https://securedrop.org
  Whistleblower submission system used by 70+ news organizations.
  Tags: whistleblower, security

- Freedom on the Net: https://freedomhouse.org/report/freedom-net
  Annual internet freedom assessment of 70 countries.

- Google Transparency Report: https://transparencyreport.google.com/traffic/overview
  Traffic and disruption data from Google's network.
  Tags: reports, data

- Voidly Censorship Index: https://voidly.ai/censorship-index
  Live, data-driven censorship rankings from 19.6M measurements.

- World Press Freedom Index: https://rsf.org/en/index
  180 countries ranked by press freedom.
  Tags: reports, press

## Developer Tools & Libraries
*Libraries and tools for building freedom technology.*

- Arti: https://gitlab.torproject.org/tpo/core/arti
  Tor client in Rust. Modern, memory-safe.
  Tags: dev, tor

- Cloak: https://github.com/cbeuw/Cloak
  Pluggable transport disguising traffic as HTTPS.
  Tags: dev, circumvention

- Noise Protocol Framework: https://noiseprotocol.org
  Framework for building crypto protocols. Used by WireGuard, libp2p.
  Tags: dev, encryption, protocol

- OONI Probe: https://github.com/ooni/probe-cli
  Run censorship tests from your device.
  Tags: dev, measurement

- OpenPGP.js: https://openpgpjs.org
  JavaScript OpenPGP for browser and Node.js.
  Tags: dev, encryption

- Stem: https://stem.torproject.org
  Python library for Tor.
  Tags: dev, tor

- Voidly Agent SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@voidly/agent-sdk
  E2E encrypted agent messaging. Double Ratchet, X3DH, post-quantum. Install: `npm install @voidly/agent-sdk`
  Tags: dev, agent, encryption

- Voidly MCP Server: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@voidly/mcp-server
  83 censorship intelligence tools for AI assistants. Install: `npx @voidly/mcp-server`
  Tags: dev, mcp, ai

- WireGuard Tools: https://www.wireguard.com/repositories/
  Official WireGuard userspace tools.
  Tags: dev, vpn

- age: https://github.com/FiloSottile/age
  Simple, modern file encryption. Designed to replace PGP.
  Tags: dev, encryption

- libsodium: https://doc.libsodium.org
  Modern, easy-to-use cryptography library.
  Tags: dev, encryption

- obfs4: https://gitlab.torproject.org/tpo/anti-censorship/pluggable-transports/obfs4
  Tor pluggable transport for traffic obfuscation.
  Tags: dev, tor, circumvention

## Datasets
*Open datasets for censorship research and analysis.*

- CensoredPlanet Data: https://data.censoredplanet.org
  Longitudinal censorship datasets (DNS, HTTP, HTTPS).
  Tags: dataset, censorship

- Citizen Lab Test Lists: https://github.com/citizenlab/test-lists
  URL test lists used by measurement platforms.
  Tags: dataset, censorship

- GFWatch: https://gfwatch.org
  Longitudinal dataset of China's Great Firewall DNS censorship.
  Tags: dataset, censorship

- OONI Data: https://ooni.org/data/
  Complete archive of network measurements.
  Tags: dataset, censorship

- Voidly Global Censorship Index: https://huggingface.co/datasets/emperor-mew/global-censorship-index
  Live JSON. 119 countries, block rates, risk tiers.
  Tags: dataset, censorship, ml

- Voidly OONI Historical Archive: https://huggingface.co/datasets/emperor-mew/ooni-censorship-historical
  1.6M records, 10 years, 120 countries. Parquet.
  Tags: dataset, censorship, ml
